title: Changelog - May 2017
content:
## Changelog - May 2017


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093664

New Features:

- We updated the Breadcrumb URLs on Details Pages of Posts to change dynamically based on the name of the Post Type.

- We added additional SPAM protection to all of the public-facing default forms.  This will block even more types of SPAM form submissions from bots and other automated tools. The Forms Involved are: Contact Us, Get Matched and Newsletter.

- We updated the Request Review and Invite Colleagues features in the Member Dashboard.

Enhancements / Fixes:

- We improved the functions and widgets that are involved with the Upload Files functionality. This update will impact the following section of the Software: Profile Photo and Logo page, adding images to all Post types, Curriculum Vitae / Brochure upload, Admin Image Manager, and Froala Image Upload.

- We updated the method by which Design Settings are saved to prevent an issue that was causing Design Settings to save as blank in some cases.

- Bug fixes to the New Leads Module, New Reviews Module, Google Location System, Add-on Manager System, and Member System.

- In all, more than15 bugs were fixed throughout the software.
